smyx-fish-egg-incubation-stage-analysis v1.0.3

- Updated identity handling: user identity ("open-id") is now managed automatically by the script, removing the requirement to prompt or display identity to the user.
- Skill usage documentation has been rewritten for clarity, with new tables, workflows, and constraint explanations.
- The rules for history report queries now strictly enforce fetching from the cloud API only; local or memory-based report access is explicitly disallowed.
- Removed two legacy files (scripts/api_service.py, skill-card.md) as part of refactoring.
- Parameter handling and workflow steps in scripts and configs have been synchronized for a more streamlined user experience.

- Improved configuration handling and open-id retrieval logic in accordance with updated requirements.
- Adjusted shared utility functions and data access logic for better modularity.
- Updated configuration file locations and reading priority.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Updated config file loading to prioritize scripts/config.yaml in the skill directory for open-id acquisition.
- Revised documentation to reflect the new open-id retrieval priority and updated config file locations.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
- Cleaned up and reorganized the internal structure of requirements, configs, and utility script imports.
- No changes to user-facing analysis features or output.

Initial release of smyx-fish-egg-incubation-stage-analysis:

- Automatically analyzes macro images of fish eggs via fixed tank cameras to detect color changes and eye-spot appearance, determining incubation stages.
- Provides structured reports every 6 hours, including incubation stage, color/eye-spot ratios, hatching forecasts, and actionable suggestions for breeders.
- Supports multi-level reminder strategy (progress, preparation, urgent, warning), tailored to fish species, water temperature, and spawning time.
- Strict open-id acquisition procedure ensures user identification for report saving and retrieval.
- Automatic historical report querying and data handling via API; prohibits use of local memory for records.
- Designed for easy integration into smart breeding tanks or mobile macro setups, aiding both hobbyist and professional fish breeders.
